systemSummary.name: Apache Airflow Workflow Orchestration Platform
systemSummary.description: Distributed batch workflow orchestration platform expressing workflows as Python DAGs, scheduling tasks via relational database state machines, and dispatching execution to pluggable workers and triggerers.

schedulerService.description: Core scheduling daemon evaluating DAG schedules, checking upstream dependencies, and enqueuing tasks to executors.

triggererService.description: Asynchronous daemon executing deferrable operator triggers as non-blocking coroutines.

executorLayer.description: Pluggable task execution infrastructure (CeleryExecutor, KubernetesExecutor, LocalExecutor).

databaseLayer.description: Relational metadata database storing DAG, DagRun, TaskInstance, Trigger, and XCom models using SQLAlchemy.

durableExecutionModel.dagEvaluation: Workflows are authored as Python code defining DAG objects composed of Operator tasks. Schedulers parse DAGs, evaluate schedules via Timetables, and manage DagRun/TaskInstance state transitions in the database.
durableExecutionModel.relationalState: Durable state is stored in relational tables (dag_run, task_instance, xcom). Scheduling decisions use row-level locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) to enable multi-scheduler HA.
durableExecutionModel.deferrableTriggers: Long-running waiting tasks yield execution to TriggererJobRunner, freeing worker slots. Triggers poll asynchronously and wake up task instances upon completion.
durableExecutionModel.workerHeartbeats: Running task instances heartbeat to the database. Schedulers detect dropped or killed workers via zombie purge routines and re-enqueue eligible tasks.
durableExecutionModel.taskMapping: Dynamic task mapping expands mapped tasks into N indexed TaskInstance rows based on upstream XCom returns.
